scenes.text: The hallway light flickered out at 23:41, leaving only the cold kitchen window. A shadow moved in the kitchen at 00:06, but the temperature dropped to 17°C by 00:07.

The radio crackled to life at 00:09, playing a static-laced melody that seemed to echo through the walls. By 00:12, the front door sensor marked it closed, yet the hallway light flared back on at 00:13.
The last whisper was the hallway light's return. It had been the clockwork ghost of the house itself, counting down to the next moment with every switch.

events.text: 00:06 — Motion detected in the empty kitchen.
00:07 — Kitchen temperature dropped from 21 to 17 degrees.
00:09 — Radio switched on with no station selected.
